translations.idiomatic: In high antiquity the three sages succeeded one another and consulted the four peaks to enlarge abdication.

sentences.zh: 惟先王之有作，永垂範於無窮。

translations.literal: Only the former kings' having made it—forever handing down a model without end.
translations.idiomatic: What the former kings established endures forever as a model.

sentences.zh: 及劉氏致禪，實堯是法，有魏告終，亦憲茲典。

translations.literal: And when the Liu house effected abdication, truly Yao was the model; when Wei announced its end, it also took this canon as law.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liu house abdicated, it followed Yao; when Wei ended, it followed the same canon.

sentences.zh: 我世祖所以撫歸運而順人事，乘利見而定天保者也。

translations.literal: Our high ancestor therefore calmed the returning cycle and followed human affairs, riding profit to appear and fixing Heaven's preservation.
translations.idiomatic: Our high ancestor calmed the turning cycle, followed human affairs, seized the moment, and secured Heaven's blessing.

sentences.zh: 而道不常泰，戎夷亂華，喪我洛食，蹙國江表，仍遘否運，淪沒相因。

translations.literal: Yet the Way is not constantly peaceful; barbarians disordered China; we lost our Luo food; the state was cramped on the river's south; again encountering obstructed fortune, sinking and perishing followed in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Yet peace did not last; barbarians ravaged China; we lost Luoyang; the state was driven south; fortune turned again and ruin followed.

sentences.zh: 逮于元興，遂傾宗祀。

translations.literal: Reaching Yuanxing, the ancestral sacrifices then toppled.
translations.idiomatic: By Yuanxing the ancestral sacrifices had fallen.

sentences.zh: 幸賴神武光天，大節宏發，匡復我社稷，重造我國家。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on divine martiality that illuminated Heaven, great integrity blazed forth, he rectified our altars of state and remade our house and state.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately divine martiality illuminated Heaven and great integrity blazed forth; the altars were restored and the state remade.

sentences.zh: 惟王聖德欽明，則天光大，應期誕載，明保王室。

translations.literal: Only the king's sage virtue is reverent and bright; then Heaven's radiance is great; responding to the term he was born and loaded; he brightly protected the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Your sage virtue is reverent and bright; Heaven's radiance is great; born for the age, you protected the royal house.

sentences.zh: 內紓國難，外播宏略，誅太憝於漢陽，逋僭盜於沂渚，澄氛西岷，肅清南越，再靜江、湘，拓定樊、沔。

translations.literal: Within he relieved the state's difficulty; without he spread the grand plan; he executed the great villain at Hanyang; the fleeing usurper was driven off at Yizhu; he cleared miasma in western Min; solemnly cleared the southern Yue; again quieted Jiang and Xiang; extended and fixed Fan and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Within you eased the state's peril; without you spread grand strategy; you destroyed the great villain at Hanyang, drove off usurpers at Yizhu, cleared the west, pacified the south, quieted Jiang and Xiang, and secured Fan and Mian.

sentences.zh: 若乃永懷區宇，思一聲教，王師首路，則伊、洛澄流，稜威崤、潼，則華嶽褰靄，偽酋銜璧，咸陽即序。

translations.literal: As for forever cherishing the realm, thinking to unify sound teaching—when the royal army took the first road, then Yi and Luo had clear currents; awl-edge authority at Xiao and Tong, then Mount Hua lifted mist; false chiefs held jade disks and Xianyang was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Forever cherishing the realm, you unified civilization. When the royal army marched, Yi and Luo ran clear; your authority at Xiao and Tong made Mount Hua bow; false rulers surrendered and Xianyang was ordered.

sentences.zh: 雖彝器所銘，詩書所詠，庸勳之盛，莫之與二也。

translations.literal: Though ritual vessels are inscribed and odes and documents are chanted—the flourishing of meritorious achievement has none to pair with it.
translations.idiomatic: Though bronze and odes record such deeds, none match your achievement.

sentences.zh: 遂偃武修文，誕敷德政，八統以馭萬民，九職以刑邦國，思兼三王，以施四事。

translations.literal: Then he halted martiality and cultivated letters, broadly spread virtuous government; eight threads to drive the ten thousand people; nine duties to punish the state—thinking to combine the three kings and deploy the four affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Then you halted war and cultivated letters, spread virtuous government, governed the people by eight threads and the state by nine duties, and sought to match the three kings in the four affairs.

sentences.zh: 故能信著幽顯，義感殊方。

translations.literal: Therefore trust was fixed in the hidden and manifest; righteousness moved special regions.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore your trust reached hidden and manifest realms; your righteousness moved distant lands.

sentences.zh: 自歷世所賓，舟車所暨，靡不謳歌仁德，抃舞來庭。

translations.literal: From ages that were guests, where boats and chariots reached—none did not sing of benevolent virtue and stamp-dance, coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: From every age and every land reached by cart and boat, all sang of your benevolence and came dancing to court.

sentences.zh: 朕每敬惟道勳，永察符運，天之曆數，實在爾躬。

translations.literal: I each time respectfully reflect on the Way's achievement, forever examining the talisman of fortune—Heaven's calendar and number truly rest in your person.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully reflect on your achievement and examine Heaven's mandate: the calendar truly rests in you.

sentences.zh: 是以五緯升度，屢示除舊之迹；

translations.literal: Therefore the five cords rose in degree, repeatedly showing traces of removing the old;
translations.idiomatic: The five planets rose in their courses, repeatedly showing the removal of the old;

sentences.zh: 三光協數，必昭布新之祥。

translations.literal: the three luminaries harmonized in number, necessarily displaying omens of spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: the three luminaries aligned in number, proclaiming the spread of the new.

sentences.zh: 圖讖禎瑞，皎然斯在。

translations.literal: Charts, prophecies, and auspicious omens—brightly they are here.
translations.idiomatic: Charts, prophecies, and auspicious omens shine forth clearly.

sentences.zh: 加以龍顏英特，天授殊姿，君人之表，煥如日月。

translations.literal: Added to this the dragon countenance is heroic and special; Heaven bestowed extraordinary posture; the mark of a lord of men—brilliant as sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: Your dragon countenance is heroic; Heaven bestowed a special form; your bearing as ruler shines like sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 傳稱「惟天為大，惟堯則之」。

translations.literal: Tradition says, "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it."
translations.idiomatic: Tradition says, "Only Heaven is great; only Yao matched it."

sentences.zh: 詩云：「有命自天，命此文王。

translations.literal: The Ode says: "There is a mandate from Heaven; Heaven commanded this King Wen."
translations.idiomatic: The Ode says, "There is a mandate from Heaven; Heaven commanded King Wen."

sentences.zh: 」夫「或躍在淵」者，終饗九五之位；

translations.literal: One who "perhaps leaps in the abyss" in the end enjoys the position of nine and five;
translations.idiomatic: He who "perhaps leaps in the abyss" at last receives the throne of nine and five;

sentences.zh: 「勳格天地」者，必膺大寶之業。

translations.literal: one whose "achievement grids Heaven and earth" must receive the great treasure's enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: he whose achievement matches Heaven and earth must receive the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 昔土德告沴，傳祚于我有晉；

translations.literal: In former days earth virtue announced calamity and transmitted the fortune to our Jin;
translations.idiomatic: When earth virtue failed, the mandate passed to our Jin;

sentences.zh: 今曆運改卜，永終于茲，亦以金德而傳于宋。

translations.literal: now the calendar's movement changes divination and forever ends here—also with metal virtue it is transmitted to Song.
translations.idiomatic: now the calendar turns and ends here; with metal virtue the mandate passes to Song.

sentences.zh: 仰四代之休義，鑒明昏之定期，詢于羣公，爰逮庶尹，咸曰休哉，罔違朕志。

translations.literal: Looking up to the restful righteousness of the four ages, reflecting on the fixed term of bright and dim, inquiring of the lords, extending to the many directors—all said excellent! None opposed my will.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to the righteousness of the four ages, reflecting on the cycle of light and dark, I asked the lords and officials. All said excellent; none opposed my will.

sentences.zh: 今遣使持節、兼太保、散騎常侍、光祿大夫澹，兼太尉、尚書宣範奉皇帝璽綬，受終之禮，一如唐虞、漢魏故事。

translations.literal: Now I send the commissioner with credentials, concurrently Grand Tutor, Regular Attendant, Household Master of Light Tan, concurrently Grand Commandant, Master of Writing Xuan Fan, bearing the imperial seals and cord, with the rites of receiving the end—all like the stories of Tang-Yu and Han-Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Now I send Commissioner Tan, Grand Tutor and Household Master of Light, and Xuan Fan, Grand Commandant and Master of Writing, bearing the imperial seals and cord, with the rites of abdication, following the precedents of Tang-Yu and Han-Wei.

sentences.zh: 王其允答人神，君臨萬國，時膺靈祉，酬于上天之眷命。

translations.literal: King, you must truly answer men and spirits, lord the ten thousand states, timely receive numinous blessing, and repay Heaven above's look of mandate.
translations.idiomatic: King, answer the call of men and spirits, rule the realm, receive Heaven's blessing, and fulfill the mandate Heaven has granted you.

sentences.zh: 王奉表陳讓，晉帝已遜琅邪王第，表不獲通。

translations.literal: The king submitted a memorial declining; the Jin emperor had already yielded to the Prince of Langye's residence; the memorial could not get through.
translations.idiomatic: The king submitted a memorial of refusal. The Jin emperor had already moved to the Prince of Langye's residence; the memorial could not reach him.

sentences.zh: 於是陳留王虔嗣等二百七十人，及宋臺羣臣，並上表勸進。

translations.literal: Thereupon Prince of Chenliu Qian Si and two hundred seventy others, and the multitude of ministers of the Song headquarters, all submitted memorials urging advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Then Qian Si, Prince of Chenliu, with two hundred seventy others, and all the ministers of Song, memorialized urging him to accept the throne.

sentences.zh: 上猶不許。

translations.literal: Above he still did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He still refused.

sentences.zh: 太史令駱達陳天文符瑞數十條，羣臣又固請，王乃從之。

translations.literal: Grand Astrologer Luo Da presented several tens of items of astronomical signs and omens; the multitude of ministers again firmly requested—and the king then followed them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Astrologer Luo Da presented dozens of heavenly signs and omens. The ministers pressed again, and the king at last accepted.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 未能菲躬儉 嚴可均云：「儉下疑奪一字。

translations.literal: Unable to be frugal in person and economical Yan Kejun says: "Below economical, one character is suspected to be missing."
translations.idiomatic: Unable to be frugal in person and economical—Yan Kejun says: "A character is probably missing below jian (economical)."

sentences.zh: 」殿本考證云：「躬下當有節字。

translations.literal: The Palace Edition's textual verification says: "Below gong (person) there should be the character jie (frugal)."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Edition notes: "Below gong (person) there should be jie (frugal)."

sentences.zh: 或儉下脫一用字。」

translations.literal: Or below economical one character use was omitted."
translations.idiomatic: Or the character yong (use) was dropped below jian (economical)."

sentences.zh: 公乃進督 「乃」南史作「仍」。

translations.literal: Gaozu then advanced supervision "then" in the Southern History is "still."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu then advanced supervision—the Southern History reads "still" for "then."

sentences.zh: 乃速申於當年 「申」各本並譌「由」，據建康實錄、元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: Then quickly extended in that year "extended" in all editions is erroneously "from"; corrected according to the Veritable Records of Jiankang and Essentials of Governance 486.
translations.idiomatic: Then quickly reported in that year—all editions wrongly read "from" for "reported"; corrected per the Veritable Records of Jiankang and Essentials of Governance 486.

sentences.zh: 復加黃鉞 錢大昕廿二史考異云：「加當作假。

translations.literal: Again added the yellow battle-axe Qian Daxin's Notes on the Twenty-Two Histories says: "Added should be borrowed.
translations.idiomatic: Again added the yellow battle-axe—Qian Daxin's Notes on the Twenty-Two Histories says: "Jia (added) should be jia (borrowed)."

sentences.zh: 使持節得殺二千石以下，假黃鉞則可專戮節將矣。」

translations.literal: The commissioner with credentials may kill those at two thousand piculs and below; borrowing the yellow battle-axe then one may exclusively execute frontier generals."
translations.idiomatic: A commissioner with credentials may execute officials of two thousand piculs and below; with a borrowed yellow battle-axe he may execute frontier generals."

sentences.zh: 卜世未改 「卜世」各本並作「十世」。

translations.literal: The allotted age not yet changed "allotted age" in all editions reads "ten generations."
translations.idiomatic: The allotted age not yet changed—all editions read "ten generations" for "allotted age (bushi)."

sentences.zh: 按自西晉武帝至東晉安帝，已十四世，言十世，無據。

translations.literal: From Western Jin Emperor Wu to Eastern Jin Emperor An is already fourteen generations; to say ten generations has no basis.
translations.idiomatic: From Western Jin Emperor Wu to Eastern Jin Emperor An is already fourteen generations; "ten generations" has no basis.

sentences.zh: 「十世」當是「卜世」之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: "Ten generations" should be the error for "allotted age"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Ten generations" should be an error for "allotted age (bushi)"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 去秋遣康之送還司馬君者 「君」各本並作「軍」，據晉書譙剛王遜傳玄孫休之附傳、元龜七二五改。

translations.literal: Last autumn sent Kangzhi to return to the Marshal's lord "lord" in all editions reads "army"; corrected according to the Jin Shu biography of the Prince of Qiao Gang Wang Xun, appendix biography of Xuan's descendant Xiuzhi, and Essentials of Governance 725.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn sent Kangzhi to return to the Marshal's lord—all editions read "army" for "lord"; corrected per the Jin Shu biography of Xiuzhi and Essentials of Governance 725.

sentences.zh: 此公之大節 各本並脫「大」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: This is Gaozu's great integrity All editions omit the character "great"; supplemented according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: This is Gaozu's great integrity—all editions omit "great"; supplemented per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 一朝掃滌 「滌」各本並作「濟」，據南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: In one morning swept clean "swept clean" in all editions reads "crossed"; corrected according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In one morning swept clean—all editions read "crossed" for "swept clean"; corrected per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 今命使持節兼太尉尚書左僕射晉寧縣五等男湛授相國印綬 各本脫「今」字、「兼」字，並據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Now order the commissioner with credentials concurrently Grand Commandant Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Baron of the Fifth Rank of Jinning County Zhan to confer the Chief Minister's seals and cord All editions omit "now" and "concurrently"; supplemented according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Now order Commissioner Zhan to confer the Chief Minister's seals—all editions omit "now" and "concurrently"; supplemented per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 金虎符第一至第五左 「第五」各本作「第十」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Golden tiger tally first through fifth on the left "fifth" in all editions reads "tenth"; corrected according to the Southern History.
translations.idiomatic: Golden tiger tally first through fifth on the left—all editions read "tenth" for "fifth"; corrected per the Southern History.

sentences.zh: 其以相國總百揆 各本並脫「以」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Let him as Chief Minister oversee the hundred duties All editions omit the character "as"; supplemented according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Let him as Chief Minister oversee the hundred duties—all editions omit "as"; supplemented per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 上送所假節侍中貂蟬中外都督太傅太尉印綬 各本並脫「貂蟬」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Send up the borrowed tally, Attendant, sable cicada, seals and cord of Grand Commander of Court and Country, Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant All editions omit the two characters "sable cicada"; supplemented according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Send up the borrowed tally, Attendant's sable cicada, and seals of Grand Commander, Grand Tutor, and Grand Commandant—all editions omit "sable cicada"; supplemented per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「按宋、齊志皆不見侍中印綬，蓋但給朝服武冠貂蟬而巳。

translations.literal: Sun Biao's Critical Discussion of the Song Shu says: "According to the Song and Qi monographs, neither shows Attendant's seals and cord—probably only court robes, martial cap, and sable cicada were given.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Biao's Critical Discussion of the Song Shu says: "The Song and Qi monographs show no Attendant's seals and cord—probably only court robes, martial cap, and sable cicada were given.

sentences.zh: 南史侍中下有貂蟬二字，是。」

translations.literal: The Southern History below Attendant has the two characters sable cicada—this is correct."
translations.idiomatic: The Southern History has 'sable cicada' below Attendant—that is correct."

sentences.zh: 置宋國侍中黃門侍郎尚書左丞郎隨大使奉迎 「郎」三朝本、北監本、毛本、局本同。

translations.literal: Set up in the state of Song Attendant, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, and Gentlemen, who with the great envoy welcome and escort "Gentlemen" in the Three Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Bureau edition are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Set up in Song Attendants, Gentlemen of the Yellow Gate, the Left Assistant Director, and Gentlemen to welcome the envoy—"Gentlemen" matches the Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Bureau editions.

sentences.zh: 殿本、南史作「相」。

translations.literal: The Palace Edition and Southern History read "chief."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Edition and Southern History read "chief (xiang)."

sentences.zh: 李慈銘越縵堂日記補云：「當作即隨大使奉迎。」

translations.literal: Li Ciming's Supplement to the Diary of the Yue Mantang says: "It should read 'then with the great envoy welcome and escort.'"
translations.idiomatic: Li Ciming's Supplement to the Diary of the Yue Mantang says: "It should read 'then with the great envoy welcome and escort.'"

sentences.zh: 風雲玄感 「玄」各本並作「言」，據局本、文選、建康實錄、元龜二一０改。

translations.literal: Wind and clouds with dark resonance "dark" in all editions reads "words"; corrected according to the Bureau edition, Wen Xuan, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Essentials of Governance 210.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and clouds with dark resonance—all editions read "words" for "dark"; corrected per the Bureau edition, Wen Xuan, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and Essentials of Governance 210.

sentences.zh: 以徐州之海陵北東海北譙北梁豫州之新蔡兗州之北陳留司州之陳郡汝南潁川滎陽十郡增宋國 「北東海」上之「北」字，各本並脫去。

translations.literal: With the ten commanderies of Hailing, Northern Donghai, Northern Qiao, Northern Liang in Xuzhou, Xincai in Yuzhou, Northern Chenliu in Yanzhou, and Chenjun, Runan, Yingchuan, and Xingyang in Sizhou, increase the state of Song The character "northern" above "Donghai" is omitted in all editions.
translations.idiomatic: Adding ten commanderies to Song—the character "northern" above "Donghai" is omitted in all editions.

sentences.zh: 據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Supplemented according to the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Supplemented per the Southern History and Veritable Records of Jiankang.
